activation_gate.decision: Do not train, screen, impute, promote, or compare SpaMosaic in v1.
activation_gate.minimum_future_evidence: A rights-cleared participant-level spatial multi-omics collection with authoritative observation and section joins, at least one true bridge topology, enough participants for grouped evaluation, an external source, and derivative-weight permission.
activation_gate.task_gate: Register modality-native integration and imputation endpoints, donor-level uncertainty, mandatory unimodal and multimodal baselines, transductive versus frozen lanes, prospective power, and a champion gate.

gse192741.native_fit: RNA is native; H&E pixels are not a SpaMosaic omic feature matrix in the registered implementation.
gse192741.why: There is no native multi-omics bridge, the source is exposed, the hg19 annotation is unresolved, and four donors cannot support superiority.

gse292268.biological_units: 4 F2 MASLD donors distributed two per CosMx slide
gse292268.native_fit: Unimodal RNA does not test mosaic integration or missing-modality transfer.
gse292268.why: The slide and field-of-view donor map is unresolved and the donor count is inadequate.

hra007511.modalities: Visium RNA, H&E, and MALDI on adjacent sections or same-study records
hra007511.native_fit: MALDI intensity has no audited SpaMosaic preprocessing or assay likelihood, and adjacent-section observations cannot be treated as row-paired bridge modalities.
hra007511.why: Permission, participant and section joins, registration, training rights, and derivative-weight rights are unresolved.

vu2025.modalities: Visium RNA, H&E, and CODEX protein images
vu2025.native_fit: SpaMosaic can process protein abundance matrices, but CODEX cells and Visium spots are not identical observations. They require an authoritative transform and aggregation receipt before forming a bridge batch.
vu2025.why: VLP arrays mix participants, barcode boundaries are missing, CODEX registration is incomplete, and a DSA is required.

pairing_and_missingness.bridge_rule: Only same-cell, same-spot, or an explicitly registered and uncertainty-tagged common observation grid may populate two modality rows in one bridge batch.
pairing_and_missingness.adjacent_sections: Adjacent-section values remain derived estimates after registration and never become observed same-section measurements.
pairing_and_missingness.mosaic_missingness: A batch lacking an assay is structurally_missing. Permission blocks, failed joins, unprocessed derivations, and assay non-applicability keep their distinct states.
pairing_and_missingness.imputation: SpaMosaic outputs are derivable_not_observed with source-donor, reference-pool, neighbor, and uncertainty provenance; they cannot replace measured evidence in evaluation.

donor_and_graph_firewall.sample_scope: All sections, cores, arrays, fields, modalities, transforms, graphs, MNNs, and imputations from one participant remain in one fold.
donor_and_graph_firewall.spatial_graph: Construct within participant and section or core only. No edge crosses donors or unregistered sections.
donor_and_graph_firewall.MNN: Strict held-donor evaluation prohibits cross-batch query MNNs. A separate transductive mapping lane may connect one held donor to development bridges without labels and never to other held donors.
donor_and_graph_firewall.training_only: Feature selection, normalization, PCA or LSI, Harmony, smoothing, bridge selection, MNN hyperparameters, outlier filtering, latent training, imputation K, clustering, and calibration are selected with development participants.

held_donor_behavior.official_workflow: Joint and transductive; non-bridge query batches participate in MNN construction and graph-encoder training.
held_donor_behavior.frozen_lane: Not supplied by the official interface and cannot be claimed until a fixed fit-predict adapter passes section-isolation and numeric fixtures.
held_donor_behavior.claim_limit: No candidate is a project-sealed, powered spatial multi-omics source. No v1 SpaMosaic endpoint or champion exists.

interpretation: SpaMosaic is a future mosaic-integration candidate, not an active MASLD model. The current public cohorts are unimodal or too small, and the richer HRA and Vu assets are controlled, unjoined, and not natively row-paired. Its official use is a transductive joint graph fit, so held-donor mapping must never be mislabeled as inductive generalization.
